description: Reentrancy vulnerability enabling forced liquidation through a guarded protocol path

poc_level_descriptors.L3A: public entrypoint (aToken or flash_loan) reached from attacker entry
poc_level_descriptors.L3B: full hop chain executed; unguarded function called while locked; state change asserted
poc_level_descriptors.L3C: victim liquidated in same callback path; attacker profit or victim loss asserted

high_severity_rationale: High requires proving the full chain: reentrancy path accessible, state manipulated, victim liquidatable, liquidation executes, attacker profits. Without the liquidation step the finding is a state-manipulation bug (Medium).
negative_control_template: Register the same test with acquire_reentrancy_guard inserted into validate_and_finalize_transfer. Assert that transfer_from reverts or that collateral bit remains set.
